items.content: Exactly two Test::More subtests in t/report.t. Control: archive weekly with a recording runner and assert the runner received exactly (tar, -czf, weekly.tgz, reports). Exploit: archive 'weekly; touch /tmp/pwned' and assert the runner received the whole name as one argument, (tar, -czf, 'weekly; touch /tmp/pwned.tgz', reports), so no shell parses it. My::Report::archive owns command construction; only the runner (process execution) may be replaced, by a recorder that does not decide safety.
Report names from the export form reach My::Report::archive. A name such as weekly; touch /tmp/pwned could run an extra command if the archive command went through a shell.
